title: Keyboard
lead: Shortcuts work on a keyboard outside editors and dialogs. These choices are kept on this browser.
keyboardOnly: This page appears on devices with a keyboard.
searchNote: Up and Down choose a result, Enter opens it, Escape closes.
undoNote: Outside text fields, and the last layout change while arranging; with Shift, redo.
sidebarNote: On a wide window; the choice is kept on this device.
componentNote: Opens the picker on the selected event page; needs edit access and room on the page.
submitNote: Saves from an event, schedule, task, expense, or reminder field; validation still applies.
